title: Easy 8km + cadence strides
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 8km easy, then 6x20s strides at 180+ spm with 60s walk. Strides are cadence work, not speed work, stay relaxed.
GYM: none.
FUEL: none.
STOP RULE: skip the strides if the legs still feel race-heavy.
WHY: your descent cadence fell to 168 at Pirin under fatigue. 180 needs to feel normal before it can survive 900m of terraces.
